example.title: Kansas Homestead of Thomas McQuill(i)an, garage
example.place: Willow Springs vicinity, Douglas County, KS

brief: Small one-storey gable-roofed frame garage about 15 ft by 18 ft under a big bur oak. The north, east and west walls are sheathed in corrugated metal, part bright galvanized and part rusted through to red-brown, while the south gable end is tongue-and-groove vertical boards with flaking white paint and a wide board door hung from a rusty rail. Rusty corrugated metal roof with exposed rafter tails, a loose stack of roofing sheets against the wall and a sagging wire fence and post at the corner. (Garage-shed; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
